description: He asks what else his library holds on Romans 8:28 and the request lists one commentary and counts six more: the answer says the others are under In another book and carries no link of kind work, since a link only to show a book exists is never right.

request.greek: καὶ οἴδαμεν ὅτι τοῖς ἀγαπῶσιν τὸν θεὸν πάντα συνεργεῖ εἰς ἀγαθόν, τοῖς κατὰ πρόθεσιν κλητοῖς οὖσιν.
request.english: And we know that all things work together for good to those who love God, to those who are the called according to His purpose.
request.question: Which other commentaries of mine have something on this verse?
